verdict.rationale: IRCC's public work-permit page links to a "Check your application status" entry point. A public processing-times checker also gives backwards-looking estimates per application type, based on 80% of past applications. The evidence is only a link title, though: nothing shows how status lookup works or whether it reports an individual case's status without signing in, and processing times are generic rather than case-specific. Missing for 10: documentation of the status-check tool and how it works, case-specific status visible from public pages, independent or hands-on corroboration.
